main_text.p: קִרְבָּה f. Appropinquatio, Accessus: Constr. קִרְבַת אֱלֹהִים Accessu Dei, vel, ad Deum, Jesa.58.2. Psal.73.28.

קׇרְבָּן m. Oblatio, Lev.1.2. Constr. קׇרְבַּן Lev.6.20. Et cum Kibbutz: וּלְקׇרְבַּן Et ad oblationem lignorum, Neh.13.31. Aff. קׇרְבָּנוֹ Oblatio ejus, Lev.1.3. Plur. cum Aff. קׇרְבָּנֵיהֶם Oblationes suas, Lev.7.38.
main_text.head: קׇרְדּוֹם
main_text.p: m. Securis: Aff. וְאֶת־קַרְדֻּמּוֹ Securim suam, 1.Sam.13.20. Plur. וְלַהַקַּרְדֻּמִּים Et securibus, v.21. Foem. קַרְדֻּמּוֹת Secures, Jud.9.48.

קָרָה Evenit, Obvenit, Occurrit. Sapè pro ה habet א. Construitur cum Accusativo, & semel cum Dativo. Praeterit. כָּל אֲשֶׁר קָרָהוּ Quicquid obtigerat sibi, Esth.4.9. Partic.Plur.Foem. הַקְּרֹת אֹתָם Quae sibi evenerant, Gen.42.29. Futur. מִקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת־כֻּלָּם Eventus unus eveniet omnibus istis, Eccles.2.14. אֲשֶׁר יִקְרֶה לְעַמֶּךָ Quod obventurum est populo tuo, Dan.10.14. cum Kametz ad formam Verbi קְרָא. Niph. Praeterit. & Infin. נִקְרָא vide in Niphal Verbi קרא. Futur. אוּלַי יִקָּרֵה יְהוָה לִקְרָאתִי Fortasse obvium se exhibebit Dominus in occursum mihi, Num.23.3. Per Apocopam, וַיִּקֶר Et obvia factus est, versf.4. Pih. קִרָּה Contignare, Contabulare: Praeter, הַמֵּה קִרּוּהוּ Ipsi contignaverant eam, Nehem.3.3. Partic. מְקָרָה Qui contignat, Psal.104.3. Infin. לְקָרוֹת Ad contignandum, Neh.2.8. Hiph. הִקְרָה Obvenire fecit, Genes.27.20. וְהִקְרִיתֶם לָכֶם Facietis ut obveniant vobis, Num.35.v.11. id est, forte constituetis. Imper. הַקְרֵהוּנָא לְפָנַי Fac ut occurrat nunc mihi, Gen.24.12.

קׇרָה f. Tignum, Trabs: קוֹרָה אֶחָת Trabem unam, 2.Reg.6.2. בְּאוּ בְּצֵל קָרָתִי Venerunt in umbram tigni mei, Gen.19.18. id est, in tabulati vel tecti mei praesidium: Plur. קוֹרוֹת Tigna, Cant.1.17. 2.Par.3.7. Aliam significationem vide in initio Radicis.

page.notes: Large Hebrew headwords (קׇרְדּוֹם, קָרָה, and the initial קׇרָה at the foot) are set in larger type; the first is treated as a heading, the second is run into its paragraph. Hebrew vowel points are reproduced from a low-resolution scan and may be imprecise, especially in the Hiphil, Pihel and Niphal forms and in the Plural/Construct forms of קׇרָה. Verse references such as "versf.4." and "Genes.27.20." are copied as printed. The printed "Jesa" is kept as printed.
